[[File:Mixed hide armour equipped male.png|thumb|width=465x465|Mixed hide armour on body type A.]]
'''Mixed hide armour''' is a set of [[ranged armour]] obtained either through Crafting with [[Mixed hide base]]s or by having [[Pellem]] in the [[Hunter Guild]] make them. Pellem will create your desired piece of armour when provided the required furs and 20,000gp per piece. The only exception on price is for the boots at 17,500gp. Players need 46 [[Hunter]] to access Pellem's hide-making services. An [[Ironman Mode|Ironman]] looking to create the full set will need level 72 Hunter to acquire the materials.

Requiring level 60 [[Ranged]] and 50 [[Defence]], the armour set boasts some melee strength bonuses that complement the [[hunter's spear]]. The [[Mixed hide legs|legs]] have no Defence level requirement, similar to [[dragonhide armour]]. The set's low cost and relatively high stats make it a popular low-risk choice for activities in the [[Wilderness]].

The complete set can be stored in the [[armour case space]] of a [[costume room]] in a [[player-owned house]].
